BREAKING: Starlink is now available on Aer Lingus transatlantic flights from Shannon Airport in Ireland.

Passengers can now enjoy free high-speed broadband at 35,000 feet, with speeds comparable to — or even better than — those at home.

Following overwhelmingly positive customer feedback, Aer Lingus expects 100% of its long-haul fleet to be equipped with Starlink by the end of 2026.

BREAKING: Airtel Africa and SpaceX have launched Starlink Mobile in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. 🇨🇩

This marks the first commercial Starlink Mobile deployment in Africa.

Eligible customers can sign up through the MyAirtel app and receive a **30-day free trial.

The service supports SMS messaging and low-data applications, while also helping industries like transport, logistics, healthcare, agriculture and mining stay connected.

Starlink Mobile can also provide backup communications during natural disasters and mobile network disruptions.
